name: Lex
tagline: Lex is a minimalist AI writing tool designed around the experience of thinking and writing together. When you get stuck, pressing a button summons GPT-powered suggestions directly in your document. It also supports AI feedback, document sharing, and comment threads, making it popular among essayists and newsletter writers.
